# Vendored dependency: cytoscape.js

- Source: https://unpkg.com/cytoscape@3.30.4/dist/cytoscape.min.js
- Version: 3.30.4 (pinned)
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE` in this directory)

Vendored so the admin UI's Graph tab does not depend on a third-party CDN
being reachable at runtime. To update, download the same two files for a
newer pinned version from the same npm package and replace them here.
